name: smwmusic-sonic-the-hedgehog-4-episode-i-gears-of-the-netherworld-mad-gear-zone-act
title: Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode I - Gears Of the Netherworld ~ Mad Gear Zone Act 3 (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Mad Gear Zone Act 3 from Sonic: The Portable. Was in the mood for another Sonic 4 theme, and it's from a zone that I actually find better than its original counterpart (could be just me or the game. idk for sure.).

Another banger too, 'cuz Mad Gear, unlike Metropolis, has some intense banging-ass tunes that fit the dark industrial stage incredibly well, especially this one, despite its short length. It's probs my favorite track from this game.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G# Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. A Minor (Original Pitch)
